note: Campground in Calling Lake Provincial Park, 55 km north of Athabasca on Hwy 813, leased to and run by the MD of Opportunity as Calling Lake Municipal Campground. Two loops of sites back from the shore, with a boat launch, a beach and a fish-cleaning station. No water to fill RVs. --Claude
